correctness.rationale: Every support of at most four queries uses at most eight endpoints. An all-length block-inflation lemma proves equivalence to the standardized endpoint support; a finite complete enumeration of all permutations on up to eight points checks every trace and the explicit obstruction criterion. Both quartic forbidden sign assignments are also disproved directly. The checker covers 0..4 queries without sampling, and a separate program verifies the padding mechanism in 16,169 small instances. No statement for supports of size five or more is inferred.

originality.rationale: The proposed theorem is about realizability of every Boolean labeling on every at-most-four-pair support of the position-inversion concept class Av_n(321), including two quartic minimal obstructions and exact first occurrences. Janson studies random pattern counts and inversion graphs, Bożyk et al. study graph vertex deletion, and Raz uses a distinct position-order VC notion. Accessible literature searches did not identify a statement or stronger theorem implying the exact forbidden families. This is a qualified literature-based PASS, not a historical-uniqueness guarantee.

value.rationale: The exact first failure of checking all sub-supports of size at most three is a natural local completion boundary for restricted comparison relations. The rank-four theorem identifies two non-equivalent ordered obstruction patterns first visible on six endpoints, gives all obstruction counts for every n, and exhibits failure of matroidal exchange. It is a structural classification of every low-rank obstruction, not an arbitrary small example; larger-rank classification is explicitly open.
